senses.gloss: m. (a corrupt., prob. to be read: פְּרֵיטוֹר praetor, πραίτωρ) judge.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 37:2">Ex. R. s. 37</cite> <he>אוהבו של מלך קומיס ור׳</he> a friend of the king (who was made) Comes and judge.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 37:2">Ib.</cite> <he>עשאו ר׳ שנ׳ וכ׳</he> the Lord made him (Moses) a judge, for it is said, and Moses sat to judge &c. (<cite ref="Exodus 18:13">Ex. XVIII, 13</cite>).
